name: io.github.j0hanz/filesystem-mcp
title: Filesystem MCP
description: A local filesystem MCP server that lets LLMs and AI agents read, write, search, diff, patch, and manage files safely and efficiently.

packageArguments.description: Optional root directory path the MCP server is allowed to access. If omitted, roots can be provided by the MCP Roots protocol or --allow-cwd.
